ImageDescription.value: Gateway with gothic stone benches - Former canon's house /Grand canon mansion(?). Built in the first quarter of the 14th century. The is the oldest building in the city. It was rebuilt in 1844 by Antal Piatsek. Since 1955, the permanent exhibition of our Janus Pannonius Zsolnay collection has been on display. Monument plaque: 'Earliest data from 1324. Gothic gateway Rebuilt several times. Renaissance fresco remains on its facade'. Plaque about here established the first public library of HUngary in 1477 by canon György Handó Immaculata relief with CoA by Ferenc Speth (mid 18th cent.) above gate. In the courtyard: bust of Vilmos Zsolnay by Alajos Stróbl (1890 ceramic), also in courtyard: ceramic decorations as vases. lions, jars - 2 Káptalan Street, Belváros (Inner City) neighborhood, Pécs, Baranya County, Hungary.
